title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct study environments on and near St. John’s University’s Queens campus, documented by the University’s campus study-spots guide and supporting service pages.

cards.title: St. Augustine Hall
cards.subtitle: Main Library · Queens campus
cards.notes: Set up in the main library for quiet zones, group tables, and Wi-Fi. Reserve a group study room at the third-floor Circulation Desk when needed.
cards.short_summary: Library setting with both quiet and collaborative study options.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Augustine Hall is St. John’s main library and offers quiet study rooms, group tables, and Wi-Fi; group rooms are reservable at the third-floor Circulation Desk.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: The Main Queens Library lists its address as St. Augustine Hall, 8000 Utopia Parkway; verify current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: The Great Lawn
cards.subtitle: In front of St. Augustine Hall · Queens campus
cards.notes: Bring a charged laptop and use the outdoor tables or shaded seating in front of St. Augustine Hall when an open-air work session suits your plan.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor campus setting with tables, shade, and Wi-Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Lawn, located in front of St. Augustine Hall, has lawn seating, tables, shaded areas, and outdoor Wi-Fi access.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and seating availability vary; use this space during normal campus access hours.

cards.title: Starbucks at the D’Angelo Center
cards.subtitle: Third floor · D’Angelo Center
cards.notes: Use the lounge seating and Wi-Fi for a laptop session in the D’Angelo Center. Check the venue’s current operating details before relying on it.
cards.short_summary: Campus café seating for a more active study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s identifies Starbucks on the third floor of the D’Angelo Center as having lounge seating and Wi-Fi access.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of the D’Angelo Center; food and beverage purchases may be available but are not required by this listing.

cards.title: Tobin Private Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Peter J. Tobin College of Business · Queens campus
cards.notes: Look for an available private room in Tobin when classes are not in session; use it for focused solo work or a small project meeting.
cards.short_summary: Private rooms intended for quieter individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tobin private study rooms are available to students when classrooms are not in session and support solo or group study.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: Availability is contingent on classrooms not being in session; confirm room access locally.

cards.title: Inclusivity Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall · Queens campus
cards.notes: Check whether the spacious lecture room is free of events, then use the open layout for individual work or a small group session.
cards.short_summary: Event-dependent lecture-room study option in Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Inclusivity Resource Center in Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall has a spacious lecture room open to students when it is not in use for events.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: The lecture room is available only when not scheduled for events; confirm availability before planning a session.

cards.title: Asian Library
cards.subtitle: Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall · Queens campus
cards.notes: Contact the University Library for current availability before heading over, then use this smaller library setting for reading and research tasks.
cards.short_summary: Cultural-resource library space with limited availability.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s identifies the Asian Library in Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hall as a study option and advises contacting the University Library because hours are limited.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: The University’s guide states that library hours are limited; contact the University Library for current availability.

cards.title: St. Vincent Health Sciences Center
cards.subtitle: St. John’s University · Queens
cards.notes: Use the center’s modern classrooms or lecture halls for a focused session when space is open; confirm building access and room availability first.
cards.short_summary: Modern academic building with classroom and lecture-hall settings.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s describes the St. Vincent Health Sciences Center as offering modern classrooms, lecture halls, Wi-Fi, and quiet study spaces.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building access and whether a classroom or lecture hall is available before arriving.

cards.title: Technology Commons
cards.subtitle: Marillac Hall, second floor · Queens campus
cards.notes: Work at a designated laptop area, connect to campus wireless, and use wireless printing resources. Bring a valid St. John’s ID for computer-lab access.
cards.short_summary: Technology-focused workspace with laptop areas and printing support.
cards.evidence_claim: Technology Commons is on Marillac Hall’s second floor; St. John’s provides designated laptop work areas, wireless access, and wireless printing resources in its computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; a valid St. John’s ID is required for computer labs.

cards.title: University Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: St. Augustine Hall, Room 103 · Queens campus
cards.notes: Pair independent work with a tutoring visit, use a quiet area, or reserve a group room for four or more students working on a project.
cards.short_summary: Academic-support hub with tutoring, quiet areas, and reservable group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Learning Commons has quiet areas and reservable group rooms for study or group projects of four or more students, and is located in St. Augustine Hall, Room 103.
cards.access_notes: Located in St. Augustine Hall, Room 103; students must have Storm Cards to enter. Reserve group rooms for study or projects of four or more.

cards.title: Coffee Cloud
cards.subtitle: 138-28 Queens Boulevard · Jamaica, NY
cards.notes: For an off-campus change of setting, plan a laptop session around the café’s seating and Wi-Fi, and verify current hours directly before traveling.
cards.short_summary: Off-campus café identified by St. John’s as a Wi-Fi-equipped study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s identifies Coffee Cloud at 138-28 Queens Boulevard as an off-campus study location with Wi-Fi and seating.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Places to Study on and near St. John’s Queens, NY, Campus
cards.access_notes: St. John’s lists the address as 138-28 Queens Boulevard, Jamaica; verify current café hours and access policies directly.
